summary.text: Trojan whom Teucer laid low in his bow-roll before the ships — distinct from Chromius son of Priam whom Diomedes slew, from Chromius among Nestor's Pylians, and from the Lycian Chromius whom Odysseus killed.

story.text: Whom of the Trojans did peerless Teucer slay? After Daetor he brought Chromius down with godlike Lycophontes, Amopaon, and Melanippus, one after another, to the bounteous earth while Ajax screened him with his shield.
